title: AWS Retail Store Sample App
summary: A five-service retail application on Amazon ECS: Aurora, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, ElastiCache and Amazon MQ behind an Application Load Balancer. StackToIT read the ECS Terraform estate and wrote a STACKIT migration package.

key_findings.title: Nothing is DIRECT
key_findings.text: All 44 present units need at least a reconfiguration: 34 RECONFIGURE, 9 REPLATFORM (Aurora → MariaDB/PostgreSQL Flex, OpenSearch, ElastiCache → Key Value Store, Amazon MQ → RabbitMQ, ECS → SKE), 1 REDESIGN (DynamoDB has no STACKIT counterpart; MongoDB Flex or PostgreSQL JSONB are the named options).

key_findings.title: The source provider is unpinned
key_findings.text: The upstream estate commits no .terraform.lock.hcl. StackToIT caps every unit at MEDIUM confidence, marks none automation-eligible, and names the two remedies (lock aws 5.100.0, or raise the constraint to ~> 6.0 and lock 6.67.0).

key_findings.title: Catalog is deployment-blocked
key_findings.text: The catalog service depends on OpenSearch 3.3; the STACKIT region offers version 2. The draft stays blocked until a test shows the application works on that version or an architecture decision is recorded.

key_findings.title: Four STACKIT API steps wait for an opt-in
key_findings.text: Secrets Manager steps call a pre-release STACKIT API. The plan does not make the calls until the customer allows them in the decisions file; this is the first required action of the run.

key_findings.title: No cost comparison is stated
key_findings.text: The source does not name its AWS region, so no AWS price was fetched. 5 of 14 STACKIT lines are priced (878.34 EUR partial, list prices); the report refuses to call a one-sided subtotal a saving.

publication.outside_manifest_note: review/ is the customer's answer area the run writes beside its files; it is excluded from the manifest by design. manifest.json lists every other file.
publication.statement: The output folder is published exactly as StackToIT wrote it. No file was removed, edited or redacted; stacktoit verify passes on the published copy.
